title: Chizkiyah ben Gurion or Garon
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Mishnah Shabbat 1:4 in the phrase: “These are among the halakhot that were stated in the upper chamber of Chananyah ben Chizkiyah ben Gurion.” In the Gemara there, 13b, “ben Garon.” In Chagigah 13b and Menachot 45a his son is named only as Chananyah ben Chizkiyah. Hyman says that his son Chananyah wrote Megillat Taanit, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The son is named Chananyah ben Chizkiyah in the cited passages; that is not an alternative name for the father who heads this entry. The work-authorship statement remains Hyman’s claim.
